rationales: Milk is a colloid and is therefore heterogeneous.
Ink is often treated as a uniform mixture in this classification, though its composition can vary.
Milk of Magnesia is a suspension and is heterogeneous, making the question ambiguous because milk is also heterogeneous.
Sugar solution is a homogeneous mixture.
2 M has the greatest amount of solute per litre and is the most concentrated.
1 M is less concentrated than 2 M.
0.5 M is less concentrated than 1 M and 2 M.
0.25 M is the least concentrated option.
[He] 2s¹ is the configuration of lithium, not sodium.
Sodium has the configuration [Ne] 3s¹.
[Ar] 4s¹ is the configuration of potassium.
[Kr] 5s¹ is the configuration of rubidium.
Environmental chemistry studies chemical processes in the environment, not industrial manufacture.
Nuclear chemistry studies changes involving atomic nuclei.
Industrial chemistry deals with large-scale commercial chemical manufacture.
Organic chemistry studies carbon compounds.
Deuterium combines with oxygen to form heavy water, D₂O.
Deuterium is not used to make soft water.
Deuterium is not used to make hard water.
Ordinary light water is H₂O, not D₂O.
The seventh period contains more than 23 elements.
The seventh period contains 32 elements.
Eighteen elements occur in the sixth period’s d-block, not in the entire seventh period.
Eight is the number of elements in the first period, not the seventh.
Nitrogen in NH₃ has a complete octet.
Each nitrogen atom in N₂ has a complete octet.
Each oxygen atom in O₂ has a complete octet.
Boron in BF₃ has only six electrons around it, so BF₃ is electron deficient.
The electronegativity difference is not 2.1.
The electronegativity difference is not 3.0.
Using H = 2.1 and Cl = 3.0, the difference is 0.9.
The electronegativity difference is not 0.6.
KCl solubility changes more with temperature than NaCl’s does.
KNO₃ solubility increases markedly with temperature.
NaNO₃ solubility increases markedly with temperature.
NaCl solubility changes only slightly with temperature.
At a fixed volume, 0.25 M is the most dilute solution and contains the greatest proportion of water.
0.5 M is more concentrated than 0.25 M.
1 M is more concentrated than 0.25 M.
2 M is the most concentrated option and contains the least water proportionally.
Halogens have seven valence electrons with the configuration ns²np⁵.
ns²np⁶ is the valence-shell configuration of noble gases.
ns²np⁴ is characteristic of group 16 elements.
ns²np¹ is characteristic of group 13 elements.
H₂O is not the empirical formula of glucose.
Dividing glucose’s molecular formula C₆H₁₂O₆ by six gives CH₂O.
C₆H₆ is not the empirical formula of glucose.
C₆H₁₂O₆ is glucose’s molecular formula, not its simplest formula ratio.
A mixture can be separated into its components by physical means.
An element cannot be broken down into simpler substances by ordinary physical separation.
A compound is separated into its elements by chemical, not physical, means.
A radical is not a mixture that can be separated into components by physical means.
J.J. Thomson proposed a model with embedded electrons, not electron orbits.
Rutherford proposed a nuclear model but did not introduce quantized electron orbits.
Bohr used the concept of fixed electron orbits in his atomic model.
Planck introduced the quantum concept, not the orbital model of the atom.
Ionic forces are strong attractions between oppositely charged ions.
Metallic bonding holds metal atoms together and is stronger than intermolecular attraction.
Intermolecular forces are weaker than the bonds holding atoms together within substances.
Covalent bonds are strong bonds between atoms.
